workAptitude.prompt: Your manager assigns you three urgent tasks at the same time. What is the best approach?
choices: Start all three simultaneously to save time
Ask your manager to prioritize them, then work through them in order
Complete the easiest one first to build momentum
Ignore all three until you have more clarity

workAptitude.prompt: A colleague shares confidential client information with you without permission. You should:
choices: Share it further since you already know it
Ignore it and pretend you never heard it
Remind the colleague of confidentiality policies and report if necessary
Use the information to your advantage

workAptitude.prompt: You notice a process in your team that is inefficient. What is the most professional response?
choices: Complain to other colleagues about the inefficiency
Ignore it — it is not your responsibility
Document the issue and propose an improvement to your supervisor
Change the process on your own without informing anyone

workAptitude.prompt: During a team meeting, a colleague presents an idea you believe is flawed. You should:
choices: Stay silent to avoid conflict
Interrupt and immediately point out the flaws
Wait for an appropriate moment and respectfully share your concerns with evidence
Talk to others privately to build opposition against the idea

workAptitude.prompt: You made an error that affected a client deliverable. What is the best course of action?
choices: Hope no one notices and move on
Blame the error on a teammate
Acknowledge the mistake, inform your supervisor, and propose a solution
Redo the work quietly without informing anyone

workAptitude.prompt: A client is upset about a delay in delivery. You are not directly responsible. You should:
choices: Tell the client it is not your fault
Avoid the client until the issue is resolved
Apologize on behalf of the team and provide an updated timeline
Ignore the complaint since you did not cause it

workAptitude.prompt: You are given a task outside your expertise. The best response is to:
choices: Refuse the task immediately
Accept it and attempt to complete it without asking for help
Accept it, research what you can, and ask for guidance where needed
Complete it using guesswork to appear capable

workAptitude.prompt: Your team is behind schedule on a critical project. As a team member, you should:
choices: Work harder individually without coordinating with others
Inform the manager and collaboratively identify where to recover time
Blame team members who are slower
Wait for your manager to notice and solve the issue

workAptitude.prompt: You receive negative feedback from your supervisor. The most productive reaction is:
choices: Become defensive and justify every decision
Ignore the feedback if you disagree
Listen carefully, ask clarifying questions, and use it to improve
Complain to colleagues about the unfair treatment

workAptitude.prompt: Two team members are in conflict, affecting team productivity. As a colleague, you should:
choices: Take sides with the person you are closer to
Encourage them to resolve it professionally or escalate to a supervisor
Spread information about the conflict to other teammates
Ignore it — it is none of your business

workAptitude.prompt: You realize mid-project that the initial plan will not achieve the goals. You should:
choices: Continue with the original plan to avoid extra work
Stop the project immediately without informing stakeholders
Reassess, communicate the issue to stakeholders, and propose adjustments
Pretend the goals were different from the start

workAptitude.prompt: A new company policy feels unfair to you and your team. The best approach is:
choices: Refuse to follow it until it is changed
Openly criticize management to build resentment
Follow the policy while raising your concerns through proper channels
Ignore the policy and do what you think is right

workAptitude.prompt: You are asked to present a project update but do not have all the information yet. You should:
choices: Make up the missing information to appear prepared
Cancel the presentation without notice
Present what you have, clearly state what is pending, and give a timeline
Ask a colleague to present in your place without explanation

workAptitude.prompt: You are overwhelmed with work and cannot meet all your deadlines. The best action is:
choices: Work through the night to finish everything without telling anyone
Inform your manager early and discuss re-prioritizing or getting support
Submit incomplete work without flagging the issues
Take a day off and hope the deadlines are extended

workAptitude.prompt: You disagree with a decision made by leadership. The most professional response is:
choices: Refuse to implement the decision
Complain loudly in the office to gain sympathy
Express your concerns respectfully through the appropriate channel, then support the final decision
Undermine the decision quietly while appearing to comply

personality.prompt: I always complete tasks on time, even when they require extra effort.
I set clear goals for myself and consistently work toward them.
I often leave tasks unfinished when something more interesting comes along.
I feel energized when working in groups and interacting with many people.
I enjoy taking the lead in group discussions or team projects.
I prefer working alone rather than in a team environment.
I find it easy to cooperate with people who have different working styles.
I genuinely care about the well-being of my colleagues.
I find it difficult to compromise when I believe I am right.
I remain calm and focused when working under tight deadlines.
I recover quickly from setbacks or professional disappointments.
I tend to feel anxious or stressed when facing unexpected changes at work.
I actively seek out new skills and knowledge relevant to my career.
I enjoy brainstorming creative solutions to complex problems.
I prefer established routines over trying new approaches.
